title: Phase 3 FRONTIER-2: Subcutaneous Mim8 Achieves Superior Zero-Bleed Rate in Haemophilia A
content: Pivotal Phase 3 FRONTIER-2 study (NCT04869267) evaluating once-weekly and once-monthly subcutaneous Mim8 in patients with Haemophilia A with and without inhibitors. Topline data demonstrates a 95% reduction in treated annualized bleeding rates (ABR) compared to prior on-demand and prophylaxis factor therapy, meeting all primary and key secondary endpoints with favorable tolerability.

title: Five-Year Durability and Vector Clearance in AAV5 Gene Therapy for Severe Haemophilia A
content: Five-year follow-up of 134 adult males with severe Haemophilia A infused with valoctocogene roxaparvovec (Roctavian, AAV5-hFVIII-SQ). Sustained median FVIII expression of 14.8 IU/dL with an 88% overall reduction in annualized bleeding rate. No late-onset vector-associated hepatic adverse events or thrombotic microangiopathies reported.

title: explorer7 Phase 3 Trial: Concizumab Prophylaxis in Haemophilia A and B with Inhibitors
content: Pivotal Phase 3 explorer7 trial results in the New England Journal of Medicine assessing daily subcutaneous concizumab in 133 patients with inhibitors. Median annualized bleeding rate was 0.0 in the concizumab prophylaxis arm versus 9.8 in the no-prophylaxis arm. No thromboembolic events observed under the revised restart dosing protocol.

title: BASIS Phase 3 Trial: Once-Weekly Marstacimab in Severe Haemophilia A & B without Inhibitors
content: Pfizer announced final 52-week data from the Phase 3 BASIS study (NCT03974113) assessing anti-TFPI monoclonal antibody marstacimab administered via auto-injector. Demonstrated a 35% reduction in annualized bleeding rate compared to routine factor prophylaxis and 92% reduction compared to on-demand therapy.

title: HOPE-B 4-Year Long-Term Study: Sustained FIX Expression in Hemgenix Treated Patients
content: CSL Behring and uniQure report 4-year durability outcomes from the pivotal HOPE-B gene therapy trial (NCT03392974) of etranacogene dezaparvovec in Haemophilia B. Mean Factor IX activity remained steady at 36.7% of normal, with 94% of patients remaining completely free of routine FIX prophylactic infusions.

title: FDA Grants Priority Review for Novo Nordisk Mim8 Biologics License Application
content: The US FDA has accepted the Biologics License Application (BLA) for Mim8 with Priority Review designation for routine prophylaxis to prevent or reduce the frequency of bleeding episodes in adult and pediatric patients with Haemophilia A with and without FVIII inhibitors. PDUFA action date set for late 2026.

title: EMA CHMP Recommends Extension of Indication for Alhemo (concizumab) in the European Union
content: The European Medicines Agency Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) has adopted a positive opinion recommending the extension of marketing authorisation for Alhemo to include adolescent and adult patients with severe Haemophilia A without inhibitors.

title: FDA Approves Hympavzi (marstacimab) as First Anti-TFPI Prophylaxis for Haemophilia A and B
content: The US Food and Drug Administration approved Hympavzi (marstacimab-hncq) for routine prophylaxis to prevent or reduce the frequency of bleeding episodes in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older with Haemophilia A or B without inhibitors, administered via once-weekly pre-filled pen.

title: EMA Committee Concludes 5-Year Safety Assessment for Roctavian Gene Transfer Vector
content: EMA CHMP safety review confirms favorable risk-benefit profile for valoctocogene roxaparvovec. Routine liver function surveillance confirmed resolution of initial alanine aminotransferase (ALT) elevations with standard short-course corticosteroid tapering regimens.

title: Safety Surveillance of Thrombotic Microangiopathy and Coagulation Kinetics in Bispecific Therapy
content: Post-marketing global pharmacovigilance analysis evaluating coagulation kinetics across 2,400 patient-years of bispecific antibody prophylaxis. Demonstrates absence of unexpected thrombotic microangiopathy events when bypassing agent dosing algorithms are strictly adhered to during breakthrough bleed management.

title: ATLAS-PPX Study: Sanofi Reports Updated Safety and Dosing Regimen for Fitusiran Prophylaxis
content: Sanofi presented long-term safety data from the ATLAS-PPX Phase 3 study of siRNA fitusiran targeting antithrombin. Revised lower dose regimen (50mg every other month) maintained antithrombin lowering between 15% and 35% with zero vascular thromboembolic complications in the updated cohort.

title: ICER Final Evidence Report Rates Novel Subcutaneous Haemophilia Therapies as High Value
content: The Institute for Clinical and Economic Review (ICER) released its 2026 Evidence Report assessing subcutaneous non-factor prophylaxes (Mim8, concizumab, marstacimab). The report concludes that next-generation bispecifics offer substantial quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gains and favorable cost-offset dynamics compared to intravenous factor replacement.

title: NICE Recommends National Reimbursement for Subcutaneous Anti-TFPI Prophylaxis in NHS England
content: The UK National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) issued final draft guidance recommending subcutaneous anti-TFPI prophylaxis for routine use across NHS England, highlighting significant patient convenience and reduced hospital infusion center visits.

title: Novo Nordisk Prepares Global Manufacturing Scale-Up Ahead of Mim8 Commercial Launch
content: Novo Nordisk has invested  million in expanding its Kalundborg and Hillerod aseptic filling and pre-filled pen assembly lines to support the projected global commercial demand for Mim8 in Haemophilia A following anticipated 2026 regulatory approvals.

title: Roche Defends Hemlibra Market Share with Real-World Registry and Pediatric Durability Data
content: As competitors advance next-generation FVIII-mimetics and anti-TFPI agents, Roche presented 7-year real-world durability evidence from over 15,000 Hemlibra-treated patients at the World Federation of Hemophilia congress, reinforcing its entrenched clinical presence.

title: India CDSCO Fast-Tracks Regulatory Pathway for Subcutaneous Non-Factor Haemophilia Therapies
content: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) in India has established an accelerated review framework for subcutaneous non-factor clotting therapies, aiming to significantly reduce bleeding morbidity in rural and underserved tier-2/3 clinical centers.

title: Gene Therapy Adoption in Haemophilia Faces Commercial Reimbursement Nuances in EU Markets
content: European health systems report varying uptake rates for single-dose gene therapies Roctavian and Hemgenix. Value-based staged installment payment agreements and long-term durability registries are emerging as standard procurement models across Germany, France, and Italy.

title: ASH 2026 Congress: Comparative In Vitro Thrombin Generation Assays for Next-Gen Bispecifics
content: Plenary presentation at the American Society of Hematology annual meeting compared peak thrombin generation capacity of Mim8, emicizumab, and recombinant FVIII. Mim8 demonstrated significantly higher procoagulant potency per mole, enabling lower therapeutic dosing volumes.

title: WFH Congress: Ultrasound Joint Health Scores Show Reversal of Arthropathy Under Subcutaneous Prophylaxis
content: Ultrasound evaluation of target joints in 210 patients enrolled in long-term non-factor prophylaxis studies demonstrated stabilized or improved HEAD-US joint scores over 36 months, proving prevention of subclinical micro-bleeds and hemophilic arthropathy progression.

title: Novo Nordisk Secures Broad Formulation and Auto-Injector Patent Protection for Mim8 Through 2041
content: The US Patent and Trademark Office and European Patent Office granted Novo Nordisk additional composition-of-matter and pre-filled dual-chamber injector pen patents for its Factor VIII-mimetic platform, fortifying its commercial exclusivity runway through 2041.

title: BENEGENE-2 Phase 3 Study: Beqvez Fidanacogene Elaparvovec in Moderate-to-Severe Haemophilia B
content: Pfizer announced 15-month results from the Phase 3 BENEGENE-2 trial of fidanacogene elaparvovec. Achieved a 71% reduction in annualized bleeding rate and non-inferiority to standard routine Factor IX prophylaxis.

title: Patient Preference and Adherence with Once-Monthly vs Once-Weekly Subcutaneous Prophylaxis
content: Discrete choice experiment across 480 adults and caregivers in Europe and North America demonstrated strong patient preference for once-monthly subcutaneous administration over weekly regimens, driven by lifestyle flexibility and reduced injection burden.

title: Asia-Pacific Health Authorities Review Tiered Pricing Frameworks for Rare Bleeding Disorders
content: Health ministries across Singapore, South Korea, and Australia published updated rare disease procurement recommendations favoring outcome-based risk sharing for novel subcutaneous prophylaxis agents.

title: FDA Schedules Advisory Committee Meeting to Review Next-Gen Factor VIII-Mimetic Clinical Profiles
content: The FDA Blood Products Advisory Committee (BPAC) has scheduled a dedicated public session to review surrogate hemostatic biomarker endpoints and annualized bleeding rate trial designs for next-generation bispecific antibodies.
